// diagnostic E0972

Jet.EveryFieldMissed

Function marked `#EveryField` never reads one or more stored fields

What

Function marked `#EveryField` never reads one or more stored fields

Why

`#EveryField(of: T)` requires the function body to directly read every stored field of `T` so adding a new field cannot silently skip hand-written save, compare, copy, or migration code

Fix

Read each missed stored field in the function body, or remove `#EveryField`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.EveryFieldMissed: Tests/UI/every_field_missed.stderr.

Error: Jet.EveryFieldMissed: Function `save_incomplete` never reads stored fields `cents`, `note`, `tag` of `Order`
  --> Tests/UI/every_field_missed.jet:18:1
    |
 18 | save_incomplete: fn(o: ^Order) -> String {
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  --> Tests/UI/every_field_missed.jet:17:1
    |
 17 | #EveryField(of: Order)
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ required by this `#EveryField` marker
 Why: `#EveryField(of: Order)` requires the body to directly read every stored field of `Order` — plain writes, `..` rest patterns, `_` discards, and passing the whole value to another function do not count
 Fix: Read `cents`, `note`, `tag` on `Order` in `save_incomplete`, or remove `#EveryField(of: Order)`
